verdict.rationale: An official Smithery CLI exists and is still maintained under the acquirer's arcadeai-labs org (npm smithery@latest). It documents registry commands (search/add/list/remove), tool commands, and a Skills surface for connecting agents from the command line. However, the shutdown notice says the service-tied CLI versions stopped working with the hosted connection services on 2026-10-31, so connection-dependent commands such as tool call are of uncertain function and the surviving CLI covers mainly the public registry. missing for 10: confirmed working connection/tool-call commands after the shutdown, first-party docs (the docs tree was removed), hands-on or independent corroboration of the current CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
smithery tool list [connection], smithery tool find [query], smithery tool get <connection> <tool>, smithery tool call <connection> <tool> [args]
The CLI itself continues under the acquirer's org (github.com/arcadeai-labs/smithery-cli, npm smithery@latest) against the public registry
